message_type.description: What kind of message this was in the tutor's terms.

what_the_student_did_with_the_idea.description: Whether the student used, explained, repeated, avoided, or otherwise worked with the idea.

independence_of_work.description: How much of the student's work was their own rather than following what the tutor supplied.

response_to_prompt.description: Whether and how the student responded to what was asked, including when they productively went elsewhere.

error_or_skipped_step.description: Whether there was a real misunderstanding that matters, a skipped step, or neither.

student_state.description: Observed engagement, impatience, tiredness, confusion, frustration, or other relevant state.

evidence_strength.description: Overall strength of evidence shown on this turn, judged conservatively.

evidence_basis.description: Why the evidence was judged at that strength, including whether it was recall, assisted, independent, interpretive, connective, or otherwise.

route_and_stop.description: Current route and stop, in ordinary words rather than internal IDs.

student_steered.description: Whether the student determined the direction of this turn.

next_move.description: The next pedagogical move chosen for this turn.

why_this_move.description: Why this move was chosen, including relevance to the student's message, route position, time, and evaluation guidance where applicable.

help_level_given.description: How much help the tutor gave on this turn.

why_this_help_level.description: Why that amount of help was appropriate.

notes.description: Brief note only when useful to explain a failed or delicate check.
